Where Things Go Wrong — Hub Stability Map

Insight: This heatmap reveals operational instability across hubs. Darker colors indicate higher incomplete return rates combined with inventory mismatches, signaling hubs requiring immediate intervention.

The Ripple Effect — Delay Amplification Analysis

Insight: Each point represents a transaction. Notice how even small numbers of missing components (1-2) can cause significant delays (30+ minutes). This demonstrates the compounding effect of incomplete returns on service efficiency.

When Problems Peak — Temporal Instability Timeline

Insight: Track monthly patterns of incomplete returns. Seasonal peaks often correlate with high-usage periods, helping predict when additional resources or stricter protocols may be needed.
